games.description: After a failed attempt to connect with NFEN, Sark returns alone. He escapes the opening maze and button level, then struggles through a dark LIDAR route with generators, pointing mannequins, and pitfalls.

games.description: A solo reading marathon through a branching Backrooms visual novel. Sark follows several routes and endings in the first story, then rapidly clicks through the remaining stories to compare their length.
